note: Written 2026-09-26, after the values were seen. The bands pre-date the data; the choice to apply them here, the mappings and the correspondences are post hoc. No pairs are declared: the export records no specimen or donor pairing. 24 h and 48 h are not compared with each other: the plate was read at 29.2 C and 35.1 C.

rule.basis: Bands copied unchanged from docs/research_sessions/plan_cases/case2_b1_rules.json, fixed on 2026-09-25 (commit d7d8bc2) for synthetic development, before this dataset was seen.
